title: Noor and the Spire
author: Ansel Dunmore
blurb: Wren Eastwick, a thief who steals memories, has spent fifteen years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. Then a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must reforge a broken covenant between realms, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
